answer: A farm of 87 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in vault, queued in ember, and jetty publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 12 identities per epoch. A farm of 4841 identities would post 1161 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
